fusions.name: Butting Prow
fusions.desc: Rams an enemy so it deals 16 damage, knocks it back 3.5 tiles and leaves it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Hoof Drumming
fusions.desc: Stamps all around you: every enemy within 2 tiles takes a blow that deals 4 damage, with a 25% chance to be [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Unshakeable Footing
fusions.desc: For 4 seconds, blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you. Transcendent damage still lands.

fusions.name: Won't Be Shifted
fusions.desc: When your health falls below half, you gain a ward worth 25% of your maximum health for 6 seconds. Once every 30 seconds.
